title: Recording: Don’t Let It Bring You Down by Wings | 1977
content:
Fair Carol, St John, US Virgin Islands
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Mark Vigars

Wings continued recording the London Town song ‘Don’t Let It Bring You Down’ on 25 May 1977.

They had started work on the song the previous day, but those takes were more rehearsals than serious attempts at recording a backing track.

On this day they filled three tape reels with new attempts. Paul McCartney initially said none were satisfactory, but one of them was later identified as the master take.

The session ended with an extended jam, which saw Wings perform songs including ‘Wide Prairie’, ‘Easter Parade’, ‘Rock Away The Blues’, ‘Till There Was You’, ‘You Are My Sunshine’, ‘Monkey Song’, ‘Train Song’, and ‘The Lady Is A Tramp’.
